new_nodes.detail: Combining thermal, gas and optical signals to infer physical state.

new_nodes.detail: Reads surface temperature and steam or volatile-compound signatures from the food.

new_nodes.label: Multispectral doneness sensor
new_nodes.detail: Compact sensor array that replaces the mechanical clockwork timer and bell.

ideas.title: Solid-State Continuous Power Modulator

new_nodes.label: Power electronics
new_nodes.detail: Switching and control of electrical power at high efficiency.

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplification
new_nodes.detail: Gallium nitride amplifiers that generate microwave energy with fine, continuous control.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state power modulator
new_nodes.detail: Continuously matches output to load, replacing the 5-step duty-cycle cam and its knob.

new_nodes.label: Load-matched power delivery
new_nodes.detail: Delivers exactly the power the food can absorb, avoiding reflected energy and off-cycle waste.

ideas.rationale: Continuous load-matched power removes the on-off duty-cycle losses of the cam design, so each joule goes into the food rather than into cycling and reflection.

new_nodes.detail: Two or more feeds with controlled phase shift that move the hot spots electronically.

new_nodes.label: Electronic field-steering array
new_nodes.detail: Feed network that replaces the glass turntable and its drive motor.

new_nodes.label: Uniform heating without rotation
new_nodes.detail: Spreads energy evenly across the cavity so no mechanical rotation is needed.

new_nodes.label: Requires dual-feed hardware
new_nodes.detail: Needs extra RF feeds and phase control electronics, adding complexity.

ideas.rationale: Eliminating the turntable motor removes its continuous draw and friction losses while avoiding cold spots that force users to reheat food and waste additional energy.

ideas.title: Magnetron Waste-Heat Recovery Loop

new_nodes.label: Thermodynamics
new_nodes.detail: Heat transfer and energy recovery in closed systems.

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe thermal transport
new_nodes.detail: Sealed passive heat pipes that move heat from the magnetron to a storage point without pumps.

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe recovery loop
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the cooling fan and exhaust vent, routing magnetron heat into a water reservoir.

new_nodes.label: Water preheating
new_nodes.detail: Warms water or food-prep liquid using energy that would otherwise be vented.

new_nodes.label: Recovery limited by temperature difference
new_nodes.detail: Usable heat depends on the temperature gap, so recovered energy is partial.

new_nodes.detail: Non-contact thermal detection using a thermopile array with cheap on-board signal processing.

new_nodes.label: Thermal sensing
new_nodes.detail: Measurement and control of temperature through radiative and conductive signals.

new_nodes.label: Doneness detection
new_nodes.detail: Determines when food reaches the required temperature so heating can stop.

new_nodes.label: Surface-only reading
new_nodes.detail: The sensor sees only the outer surface, so the core may lag behind the reading.

ideas.rationale: Ending the cycle when food is actually done eliminates the over-heating that a fixed timer wastes, and the bell is no longer needed.

ideas.title: Load-Matched Inverter Power

new_nodes.label: Solid-state inverter magnetron drive
new_nodes.detail: Variable-frequency switch-mode driver that sets magnetron output continuously to match the load.

new_nodes.label: Switch-mode power electronics
new_nodes.detail: High-frequency DC-AC conversion with feedback control of output power.

new_nodes.label: Power electronics
new_nodes.detail: Design and control of electrical energy conversion and switching.

new_nodes.label: Continuous load-matched power
new_nodes.detail: Delivers exactly the power needed, avoiding full-power bursts that are cut off by a duty cycle.

ideas.rationale: Continuous modulation removes the on/off cycling losses of a cam-driven duty cycle, so each joule goes into the food.

ideas.title: Motorless Phased-Array Field Stirring

new_nodes.label: Phased-array multi-feed emitters
new_nodes.detail: Several solid-state feed points whose relative phases are shifted electronically to move the field pattern without any moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state phase control
new_nodes.detail: Electronic steering of microwave phase and amplitude across multiple feeds.

new_nodes.label: Electromagnetic field engineering
new_nodes.detail: Shaping and steering of microwave fields inside a cavity.

new_nodes.label: Electronic field uniformity
new_nodes.detail: Achieves even heating by sweeping the field pattern electronically rather than rotating the food.

new_nodes.label: Standing-wave hot and cold spots
new_nodes.detail: Fixed cavity modes create uneven heating that rotation normally averages out.

ideas.rationale: Removing the turntable drive motor and the heavy glass plate cuts parasitic electrical draw and material use while keeping even heating.

ideas.title: Waste-Heat Thermoelectric Recovery

new_nodes.label: Thermoelectric generator module
new_nodes.detail: Seebeck module clamped to the magnetron housing that converts its waste heat into DC power for the control electronics.

new_nodes.label: Control electronics
new_nodes.detail: Low-power logic, display and sensing circuitry that draws power from the harvested supply.

new_nodes.label: Thermoelectric (Seebeck) conversion
new_nodes.detail: Direct conversion of a temperature difference into electrical voltage using semiconductor pellets.

new_nodes.label: Thermodynamics
new_nodes.detail: Study of heat transfer, energy conversion and efficiency limits.

new_nodes.label: Waste-heat electricity recovery
new_nodes.detail: Turns heat that would otherwise be lost into usable electrical power for the appliance's own logic.

new_nodes.label: Magnetron heat loss
new_nodes.detail: A large share of the magnetron's input energy leaves as heat rather than microwaves.

ideas.rationale: Recycling the magnetron's waste heat into electricity for the appliance's own electronics reduces the net mains energy needed for each cycle.

ideas.title: Lampless Camera Viewport

new_nodes.label: Micro CMOS camera
new_nodes.detail: 0.1 W camera behind a mesh-shielded port replaces the 20-25 W incandescent lamp and streams the cavity view to the user's phone.

new_nodes.label: Low-power CMOS imaging
new_nodes.detail: Sub-watt image sensor with IR-cut filter, sized for a 20 L cavity view.

new_nodes.label: Imaging electronics
new_nodes.detail: Image sensing and low-power camera design.

new_nodes.label: Remote doneness inspection
new_nodes.detail: User checks food without opening the door, so no heat or steam escapes during inspection.

ideas.rationale: Removing the 20-25 W lamp cuts lighting energy by roughly 99% per cycle and removes the heat loss caused by opening the door to check food.

ideas.title: Sensor-Terminated Cooking

new_nodes.label: Food-state sensor array
new_nodes.detail: IR thermopile plus humidity sensor replaces the clockwork timer knob and bell, ending the cycle when target doneness is reached.

new_nodes.label: Infrared thermopile sensing
new_nodes.detail: Non-contact surface temperature and moisture-loss tracking of food.

new_nodes.label: Sensor physics
new_nodes.detail: Thermal and gas sensing principles.

new_nodes.label: Doneness-based termination
new_nodes.detail: Stops energy input at the point of completion rather than after a fixed guessed time.

new_nodes.label: Steam fouling of sensor
new_nodes.detail: Condensation and splatter can obscure the sensor window and degrade readings.

ideas.rationale: Ending the cycle at true doneness eliminates the overcooking and wasted run-time that a fixed clockwork timer forces on the user.

ideas.title: Solid-State Phased-Array Heating

new_nodes.label: GaN 2.45 GHz amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state amplifier array replaces the magnetron and the 5-step duty-cycle cam, giving continuous, precisely modulated output.

new_nodes.label: Beam-steering controller
new_nodes.detail: Phase-controlled antenna array focuses energy onto the food's location and replaces the glass turntable's mixing role.

new_nodes.label: GaN power amplifiers
new_nodes.detail: Wide-bandgap transistors with high efficiency at 2.45 GHz.

new_nodes.label: Adaptive beamforming
new_nodes.detail: Real-time phase adjustment that directs RF toward absorbing material.

new_nodes.label: Wide-bandgap semiconductors
new_nodes.detail: Materials science and devices for high-efficiency power conversion.

new_nodes.label: Antenna engineering
new_nodes.detail: Array design and RF beam control.

new_nodes.label: Targeted energy delivery
new_nodes.detail: Energy is absorbed by the food rather than lost to cavity walls and idle duty cycles.

ideas.rationale: Solid-state amplifiers with focused beams remove the wasteful on/off duty cycling and direct energy only into the food, raising effective efficiency.

ideas.title: Magnetron Waste-Heat Recovery Loop

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe manifold
new_nodes.detail: Sealed heat pipes replace the magnetron cooling fan and exhaust vent, carrying waste heat away from the tube.

new_nodes.label: Pre-heat water reservoir
new_nodes.detail: Insulated tank that receives recovered heat to pre-warm water for the next cycle or for a kettle function.

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe thermal transport
new_nodes.detail: Passive two-phase heat transfer with no moving parts and no fan power draw.

new_nodes.label: Thermal engineering
new_nodes.detail: Heat transfer, recovery and management.

new_nodes.label: Waste-heat recovery
new_nodes.detail: Converts the roughly one-third of magnetron input lost as heat into useful pre-heating.

new_nodes.label: Magnetron temperature ceiling
new_nodes.detail: The tube must stay below its maximum operating temperature to avoid damage.

ideas.rationale: Capturing magnetron waste heat that is currently vented to the room recovers energy the device already pays for, reducing net consumption.

ideas.title: Zero-Hold-Power Magnetic Door

new_nodes.label: Electropermanent magnet latch
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the solenoid push-release latch; the door is held by a permanent magnet, and a brief pulse switches it, so it draws no holding power.

new_nodes.label: Electropermanent magnetism
new_nodes.detail: Magnet state switched by a short current pulse and held with no continuous current.

new_nodes.label: Magnetics
new_nodes.detail: Magnetic materials and switchable magnetic circuits.

new_nodes.label: Zero-standby door hold
new_nodes.detail: Secure door closure with no continuous electrical draw during cooking or standby.

ideas.rationale: Replacing a continuously energised solenoid latch with a pulse-switched permanent magnet eliminates standby and holding energy while keeping the door secure.

ideas.title: Zero-Watt Light Pipe Window

new_nodes.label: Ambient light pipe
new_nodes.detail: Fresnel-lens light collector on the door face feeds fibre-optic light guides that illuminate the cavity from the kitchen's ambient light.

new_nodes.label: Passive optical light guiding
new_nodes.detail: Total-internal-reflection fibre and diffuser routing ambient photons into the cooking chamber with no electrical input.

new_nodes.label: Cavity visibility at zero draw
new_nodes.detail: Lets the user check food through the door without drawing 20-25 W of lamp power.

ideas.rationale: Replacing the lamp with passive light piping removes its 20-25 W standing load while keeping the cavity visible, which directly cuts energy use per cook.

ideas.title: Doneness Probe Replaces the Clock

new_nodes.label: Infrared thermopile food probe
new_nodes.detail: Non-contact IR sensor in the cavity roof reads food surface temperature and ends the cycle at a set doneness point.

new_nodes.label: Thermal sensing and closed-loop control
new_nodes.detail: Microcontroller reads thermopile output and cuts magnetron power when target temperature is reached.

new_nodes.label: Cook-to-done termination
new_nodes.detail: Stops heating when food is ready, replacing a fixed guessed duration that often overcooks and wastes energy.

ideas.rationale: Ending each cook at actual doneness eliminates the wasted run-time that fixed timers allow, which is the largest avoidable energy loss in typical use.

ideas.title: Continuous Inverter Power Dial

new_nodes.label: Variable-frequency inverter driver
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state high-voltage driver that modulates magnetron output continuously from 0 to 700 W.

new_nodes.label: Switch-mode power electronics
new_nodes.detail: Inverter topology that replaces 50 Hz mains on/off cycling with smooth power control.

new_nodes.label: Continuous power matching
new_nodes.detail: Delivers exactly the power a food load needs, avoiding repeated start-up surges and overshoot.

ideas.rationale: Continuous inverter control removes the mechanical duty-cycle waste and transformer inrush losses, so each watt is delivered closer to where it cooks food.

ideas.title: Turntable-Free Phased-Array Stirring

new_nodes.label: Phased-array feed antennas
new_nodes.detail: Multiple small RF feeds in the cavity walls whose phase is shifted electronically to sweep hot spots across the food.

new_nodes.label: Electronic beam steering
new_nodes.detail: Phase-controlled RF interference patterns that move the energy field without mechanical rotation.

new_nodes.label: Even heating without rotation
new_nodes.detail: Produces uniform heating without spinning a mass of glass and driving a motor.

ideas.rationale: Removing the turntable motor and its rotating mass cuts parasitic electrical draw and start-up energy while keeping heating uniform, so less energy is needed for the same result.

ideas.title: Solid-State GaN Heat Engine

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Array of gallium-nitride transistor amplifiers that generate 2.45 GHz RF and can be switched per zone.

new_nodes.label: Wide-bandgap semiconductor RF
new_nodes.detail: GaN transistors operating efficiently at microwave frequencies with low conduction and switching losses.

new_nodes.label: Efficient RF generation with zone control
new_nodes.detail: Converts mains power to RF with less waste heat and activates only the amplifier modules that the load needs.

new_edges.to: Efficient RF generation with zone control

new_edges.from: Efficient RF generation with zone control

ideas.rationale: Replacing the magnetron, which wastes a large share of mains energy as heat, with zone-switched GaN amplifiers raises conversion efficiency and avoids energy spent on idle cavity regions.

ideas.title: Dielectric Feedback Auto-Thaw

new_nodes.label: RF measurement science
new_nodes.detail: Study of how electromagnetic energy is reflected and absorbed by materials.

new_nodes.label: Real-time dielectric reflectance sensing
new_nodes.detail: Measures reflected and absorbed RF power to infer the ice-to-water ratio of the load.

new_nodes.label: Self-terminating defrost
new_nodes.detail: Adjusts duty cycle automatically and stops when the target thaw state is reached, with no user timing.

ideas.rationale: Replacing guesswork timing with live sensing lets the oven stop at the exact thaw point, so frozen food defrosts fast without overcooking edges.

ideas.title: Conductive Thaw Stakes

new_nodes.label: Materials chemistry
new_nodes.detail: Design and synthesis of engineered composite materials.

new_nodes.label: Graphite-loaded composite stakes
new_nodes.detail: Lossy microwave-absorbing spikes that heat from the inside of a frozen block outward.

new_nodes.label: Thaw stake array
new_nodes.detail: Retractable grid of stakes that is pressed into frozen food to bring energy to the core.

new_nodes.label: Core-first thawing
new_nodes.detail: Thaws the dense centre of frozen food first, where ice is slowest to melt.

ideas.rationale: Delivering heat into the core of the block instead of relying on the surface speeds up the slowest part of the thaw, which is the frozen centre.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Thaw Window

new_nodes.label: Photochemistry and colour science
new_nodes.detail: Study of materials that change colour under light, heat, or chemical stimulus.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic ink film
new_nodes.detail: Ink on the door glass that shifts colour when the nearby food crosses set temperature bands.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic thaw window
new_nodes.detail: Door glass coated with a colour-shifting film, with no bulb and no electrical load.

new_nodes.label: Passive thaw-progress display
new_nodes.detail: Shows from outside the oven how far the food has thawed, without any light source.

ideas.rationale: A colour-shifting window tells the user when the food is ready to cook or refreeze, which removes the need to open the door and guess, and it draws zero power.

ideas.title: Solid-State Distributed Feed

new_nodes.label: Power electronics
new_nodes.detail: Engineering of semiconductor devices that switch and amplify electrical power.

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifiers
new_nodes.detail: Gallium nitride transistors that generate microwave energy at many points with independent phase control.

new_nodes.label: Distributed amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Dozens of small RF emitters placed around the cavity walls in place of one central magnetron.

new_nodes.label: Uniform volumetric defrost
new_nodes.detail: Delivers energy from many directions at once so the whole load thaws evenly with no hot spots.

ideas.rationale: Feeding energy in from many points at once shortens thaw time and removes the cold spots that force users to pause and flip food.

ideas.title: Steam-Latent Thaw Chamber

new_nodes.label: Thermodynamics
new_nodes.detail: Study of heat, energy transfer, and phase change.

new_nodes.label: Steam condensation heat transfer
new_nodes.detail: Steam releases large amounts of latent heat when it condenses on cold food surfaces.

new_nodes.label: Saturated steam reservoir
new_nodes.detail: Small water tank that fills the cavity with low-pressure steam before and during defrost.

new_nodes.label: Latent-heat surface thawing
new_nodes.detail: Transfers heat to the food surface through condensation, which warms and softens the ice quickly.

ideas.rationale: Steam condensing on frozen food adds far more heat per second than dry air does, and the food stays moist, so defrosting is faster and the texture holds up.

ideas.title: RF Plate Defrost

new_nodes.label: 2.45 GHz magnetron
new_nodes.detail: Current heat source; couples weakly to ice, so thawing starts slowly and then runs away on liquid pockets.

new_nodes.label: 27 MHz RF solid-state oscillator
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost GaN generator at 27.12 MHz that replaces the magnetron as the energy source.

new_nodes.label: Parallel RF electrode plates
new_nodes.detail: Metal plates on either side of the food, so the field penetrates ice evenly through its full thickness.

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplification
new_nodes.detail: Cool-running, precisely tunable RF power from inexpensive semiconductors.

new_nodes.label: Industrial RF dielectric heating
new_nodes.detail: Physics already used in factory RF thawing lines, shrunk to a countertop.

new_nodes.label: Volumetric uniform thawing
new_nodes.detail: Heats the core and rim together, avoiding a cooked outside with a frozen centre.

new_nodes.label: Ice absorbs little 2.45 GHz energy
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-frequency thawing is slow at first and uneven throughout.

ideas.rationale: Replacing the microwave source with RF electrodes lets the field penetrate ice evenly, so frozen food thaws faster and without cooked edges.

ideas.title: Thaw-Sense Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Mechanical clockwork timer knob
new_nodes.detail: Guesses defrost time from a dial and ignores load mass, temperature and thaw state.

new_nodes.label: Dielectric permittivity sensor
new_nodes.detail: Electrodes read the shift in dielectric properties as ice turns to water, which indicates thaw state.

new_nodes.label: Thermopile IR array
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost surface thermal map that shows cold spots across the load in real time.

new_nodes.label: Bell
new_nodes.detail: Audible end-of-cycle signal fixed to the timer knob.

new_nodes.label: Phone alert module
new_nodes.detail: Wi-Fi notification that replaces the bell when the food is thawed.

new_nodes.label: Permittivity and thermopile sensing
new_nodes.detail: Inexpensive sensing that reads thaw state directly instead of inferring it from elapsed time.

new_nodes.label: Sensor physics
new_nodes.detail: Dielectric spectroscopy and infrared thermometry.

new_nodes.label: Thaw-state detection
new_nodes.detail: Knows when food is soft enough, not merely when time has passed.

new_nodes.label: Automatic stop at thaw point
new_nodes.detail: Ends the cycle at the right moment, preventing overcooked edges.

ideas.rationale: Sensing the actual thaw state replaces guesswork with an automatic stop, so frozen food is defrosted fully without overcooking.

ideas.title: Acoustic Spin Tray

new_nodes.label: Glass turntable
new_nodes.detail: Rotates the food so the microwave field evens out across the load.

new_nodes.label: Turntable drive motor
new_nodes.detail: Mechanical spinner needed only to rotate the glass turntable.

new_nodes.label: Piezo ultrasonic transducer tray
new_nodes.detail: Solid ceramic plate that spins and vibrates the food using standing-wave acoustic forces.

new_nodes.label: Piezoelectric ultrasound drive
new_nodes.detail: Cheap, silent actuation with no moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Acoustics
new_nodes.detail: Standing-wave and radiation-pressure physics.

new_nodes.label: Acoustic agitation thawing
new_nodes.detail: Vibration disturbs the ice-water boundary and speeds heat transfer into the food.

new_nodes.label: Even heat distribution
new_nodes.detail: Keeps the load moving so heating stays uniform.

ideas.rationale: Ultrasonic agitation replaces a mechanical spinner and speeds heat transfer into ice, so the food thaws faster and more evenly.

ideas.title: Thaw-Map Window

new_nodes.label: 20-25 W incandescent lamp
new_nodes.detail: Lights the cavity so the user can monitor progress; it wastes energy as heat.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic thaw-zone window
new_nodes.detail: Door window with a dye layer that changes colour wherever food is still frozen.

new_nodes.label: Leuco dye thermochromic film
new_nodes.detail: Passive, self-powered colour-shifting film with no electronics.

new_nodes.label: Materials chemistry
new_nodes.detail: Reversible colour change in dye-polymer films.

new_nodes.label: Visual thaw-zone mapping
new_nodes.detail: Shows at a glance which parts are still frozen, so the user can rearrange or stop.

new_nodes.label: Metal coatings arc in microwave cavity
new_nodes.detail: Conventional conductive heating or visibility films cannot sit inside the field.

new_edges.to: Metal coatings arc in microwave cavity

ideas.rationale: A thaw-map window shows the user exactly which zones remain frozen, so they can reposition food and finish defrosting quickly.

ideas.title: Brine Ohmic Thaw

new_nodes.label: Microwave cavity and magnetron
new_nodes.detail: Field-based heating chamber that heats from the surface inward.

new_nodes.label: Brine bath with electrode pair
new_nodes.detail: Shallow food-grade salt-water bath; electrodes pass current directly through the food.

new_nodes.label: Conductive food pouch
new_nodes.detail: Sealed pouch of food in brine that carries current evenly to the frozen core.

new_nodes.label: Ohmic electrical heating
new_nodes.detail: Current flowing through a conductor generates heat throughout its volume.

new_nodes.label: Electrochemistry
new_nodes.detail: Electrolyte conduction and electrode design.

new_nodes.label: Direct volumetric thawing
new_nodes.detail: Heat is generated throughout the food rather than entering from the outside.

new_nodes.label: Frozen food is an electrical insulator
new_nodes.detail: Ice blocks current until the load partially thaws.

new_edges.to: Frozen food is an electrical insulator

new_edges.from: Frozen food is an electrical insulator

ideas.rationale: Passing current directly through a brine-coupled pouch heats frozen food throughout its volume, so it thaws far faster than surface-first microwaving.

ideas.title: Motorless Phased-Array Heating

new_nodes.label: Electronic beam steering
new_nodes.detail: Phased antenna arrays shift the RF field pattern electronically so no mechanical motion is needed.

new_nodes.label: Phased-array feed antennas
new_nodes.detail: Static antenna elements that replace the turntable motor and its rotation mechanism.

new_nodes.label: Even heating without rotation
new_nodes.detail: Spreads energy evenly across the food by steering the field, not the plate.

ideas.rationale: Eliminating the turntable motor removes its standby and running draw while keeping heating uniform, so less energy is wasted on uneven cooking.

ideas.title: Vacuum-Insulated Magnetic Door

new_nodes.label: Aerogel vacuum insulation
new_nodes.detail: Ultra-low conductivity panels that trap heat inside the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Vacuum-insulated door panel
new_nodes.detail: A door that seals magnetically and insulates itself, replacing the push-release latch design.

new_nodes.label: Retain cavity heat
new_nodes.detail: Keeps heat inside the cavity so less energy is needed to reach and hold cooking temperature.

new_nodes.label: Door heat leakage during cooking
new_nodes.detail: Heat escapes through the door and seal, forcing the magnetron to work longer.

ideas.rationale: Stopping heat escape through the door cuts the energy the magnetron must spend to maintain cooking temperature.

ideas.title: Solid-State Thaw Engine

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage (48 V DC) power transistors generate 2.45 GHz RF with no vacuum tube, cathode or high voltage.

new_nodes.label: Gallium nitride RF power amplification
new_nodes.detail: Wideband semiconductor amplifiers modulate output power continuously and linearly from milliwatts to kilowatts.

new_nodes.label: Continuous power dosing for thawing
new_nodes.detail: Sets the exact RF power per moment so frozen blocks thaw at a steady rate without on/off cycling.

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage DC link removes lethal capacitor charge
new_nodes.detail: Operating at 48 V removes the lethal HV capacitor hazard and simplifies safety certification.

new_edges.from: Low-voltage DC link removes lethal capacitor charge

ideas.rationale: Continuous, lethal-charge-free solid-state power lets the appliance hold a gentle thaw level for the full cycle, so frozen food defrosts faster and more evenly than pulsed magnetron cycling allows.

ideas.title: Phased-Array Beam Thaw (No Turntable)

new_nodes.label: Phased antenna array with beam-steering controller
new_nodes.detail: A grid of small antennas steers the RF hotspot electronically across the food, replacing physical rotation.

new_nodes.label: Electronic beam steering via RF phase control
new_nodes.detail: Adjusting the phase of each antenna sweeps the interference pattern so no spot stays cold.

new_nodes.label: Sweeps thaw hotspot across frozen mass
new_nodes.detail: Moves the energy peak through the food electronically, eliminating cold spots without moving parts.

new_edges.from: Phased antenna array with beam-steering controller
Phased antenna array with beam-steering controller
Phased antenna array with beam-steering controller
Electronic beam steering via RF phase control
new_edges.to: Phased antenna array with beam-steering controller

new_edges.from: Phased antenna array with beam-steering controller
new_edges.to: Sweeps thaw hotspot across frozen mass

new_edges.from: Sweeps thaw hotspot across frozen mass
Sweeps thaw hotspot across frozen mass

ideas.rationale: Electronically steered energy removes the turntable's slow rotation and its uneven cold spots, so a frozen block thaws uniformly and faster with no moving parts to wear out.

ideas.title: Ice-Sensing Endpoint Replaces Timer Knob

new_nodes.label: Dielectric permittivity sensor in cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: Electrodes measure the changing dielectric constant as ice melts into liquid water.

new_nodes.label: Permittivity-based phase-change detection
new_nodes.detail: Ice and liquid water differ strongly in dielectric loss, so the transition point can be read from reflected RF.

new_nodes.label: Automatic thaw endpoint detection
new_nodes.detail: Ends or steps down the defrost program when the load reaches the target thawed state.

new_edges.from: Dielectric permittivity sensor in cavity floor

new_edges.to: Dielectric permittivity sensor in cavity floor

new_edges.from: Dielectric permittivity sensor in cavity floor

ideas.rationale: Sensing the ice-to-water transition ends defrosting at the right moment, so the user no longer guesses a time and frozen food thaws quickly without partly cooking the edges.

ideas.title: 915 MHz Deep-Penetration Thaw Mode

new_nodes.label: Dual-band 915 MHz / 2.45 GHz RF source
new_nodes.detail: A tunable source switches to 915 MHz for thawing, where RF penetrates deeper into dense frozen blocks.

new_nodes.label: Lower-frequency dielectric penetration
new_nodes.detail: Longer wavelengths penetrate deeper into frozen food, reducing the surface-first heating typical of 2.45 GHz.

new_nodes.label: Deep volumetric thawing
new_nodes.detail: Heats the core of a frozen block as fast as its surface, shortening total thaw time.

ideas.rationale: Penetrating the core of a frozen block directly, rather than thawing the surface first, cuts the time a family waits for dinner.

ideas.title: Ferrite Thaw Plate Conducts Heat Into Ice

new_nodes.label: Ferrite-ceramic thaw plate
new_nodes.detail: A microwave-absorbing plate sits under the frozen food and conducts heat up into the block from below.

new_nodes.label: Microwave-to-conduction transduction
new_nodes.detail: The ferrite absorbs RF and converts it to heat, which then conducts into the frozen food through direct contact.

new_nodes.label: Conductive thaw from the base
new_nodes.detail: Thaws the bottom of the block first, so meltwater pools and speeds heat transfer into the rest of the food.

ideas.rationale: Conducting heat up from a warm plate beneath the block thaws it faster and more evenly than surface-first dielectric heating, and it gives the microwave a browning-capable surface that works around X1.

ideas.title: Light-pipe cavity illumination from ambient room light

new_nodes.label: Ambient light pipe
new_nodes.detail: Fibre-optic or acrylic light guide routed from the room-facing door face to the cavity, collecting ambient light and emitting it inside with no electrical input.

new_nodes.label: Passive optical waveguiding
new_nodes.detail: Total internal reflection in polymer light guides, with a microwave-opaque metal-mesh shield to keep RF from leaking through the guide.

new_nodes.label: RF leakage through light guide
new_nodes.detail: Optical apertures in the cavity wall can leak microwave energy unless they are shielded below cutoff.

ideas.rationale: Removing the 20-25 W lamp and powering visibility from free ambient light cuts the appliance's own energy use to zero for inspection while keeping the same see-inside function.

ideas.title: Food-temperature closed-loop heating replaces clockwork timer and power cam

new_nodes.label: Infrared food-surface sensor
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost thermopile sensor mounted in the cavity roof that reads food surface temperature and stops the magnetron at a target value.

new_nodes.label: Adaptive duty-cycle controller
new_nodes.detail: Microcontroller that modulates magnetron on-time continuously from sensor feedback, replacing the fixed-time timer and stepped cam.

new_nodes.label: Closed-loop thermal control
new_nodes.detail: Feedback control using thermal sensing to end heating when the food reaches target temperature rather than when a timer expires.

new_nodes.label: Sensor reads surface only
new_nodes.detail: Infrared sensing sees the surface, so it can misjudge the core temperature of thick or frozen food.

ideas.rationale: Stopping at the food's actual target temperature instead of a guessed time eliminates overcooking and wasted magnetron run-time, which is the largest avoidable energy loss in typical use.

ideas.title: Solid-state GaN inverter replaces mains transformer and high-voltage transformer chain

new_nodes.label: GaN high-frequency inverter
new_nodes.detail: Gallium-nitride switching stage running at around 2 MHz that generates the magnetron's high-voltage supply directly from rectified mains.

new_nodes.label: Wide-bandgap power switching
new_nodes.detail: GaN transistors switching at MHz frequencies with low conduction and switching losses, allowing a small high-frequency transformer.

new_nodes.label: Magnetron drive EMI
new_nodes.detail: High-frequency switching can create conducted and radiated emissions that need filtering.

ideas.rationale: Replacing the bulky 50 Hz iron-core transformers, which lose energy as heat and idle draw, with a high-frequency solid-state supply raises conversion efficiency and cuts standby losses.

ideas.title: Thermoelectric recovery from magnetron cooling exhaust powers the controls

new_nodes.label: Thermoelectric generator on exhaust duct
new_nodes.detail: Bismuth-telluride thermoelectric module clamped to the hot magnetron exhaust duct, generating a few watts to power the controller and sensors.

new_nodes.label: Seebeck thermoelectric generation
new_nodes.detail: Converts temperature difference across a solid-state junction directly into electrical power.

new_nodes.label: Low conversion efficiency
new_nodes.detail: Thermoelectric modules typically convert only a few percent of the heat passing through them.

ideas.rationale: Harvesting heat that the appliance currently vents to waste supplies its own control electronics, reducing net mains draw and improving the overall energy balance.

ideas.title: Phase-sequenced dual-magnetron field replaces turntable motor and glass plate

new_nodes.label: Dual-magnetron phased launcher
new_nodes.detail: Two magnetrons feeding opposed cavity ports with controlled relative phase, creating a shifting interference field that heats evenly without any moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Phased RF interference heating
new_nodes.detail: Coherent control of microwave phase to shift standing-wave hot spots across the load.

new_nodes.label: Phase coherence and cost
new_nodes.detail: Two synchronised magnetrons add cost and need careful phase locking to work.

ideas.rationale: Removing the rotating plate and its drive motor eliminates the motor's continuous draw and the energy lost to spinning mass, while phased fields keep heating uniform.

ideas.title: Gas-sensing doneness detection replaces the clockwork timer

new_nodes.label: MOX gas sensor array
new_nodes.detail: Metal-oxide sensors in the exhaust path detect volatile organic compounds and humidity released by the food.

new_nodes.label: Multivariate gas-trend classification
new_nodes.detail: A pattern model trained per food category maps the rise-and-fall curve of emitted compounds to a remaining-time estimate.

new_nodes.label: Real-time doneness estimation
new_nodes.detail: Predicts the moment the food reaches its target state and ends the cycle or alerts the user.

ideas.rationale: The food's own emitted chemistry becomes the feedback signal, so the user no longer guesses a time and the cook ends when the food is actually ready.

ideas.title: The magnetron listens to its own load

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power monitor
new_nodes.detail: A directional coupler and detector on the waveguide measure microwave power reflected back from the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Dielectric load-impedance inference
new_nodes.detail: Falling power absorption by the load, as water is driven off and the food changes state, is inferred from the reflected-power trace.

new_nodes.label: Load-absorption tracking
new_nodes.detail: Continuously reports how much energy the food is still absorbing, a direct proxy for how far it has cooked.

ideas.rationale: The appliance's own measurements tell the user how much the food is still absorbing energy, so the bell and the guessed power setting are replaced by live evidence of doneness.

ideas.title: Load-cell platter weighs moisture loss in place of the glass turntable

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable platter
new_nodes.detail: A rotating platter on strain-gauge load cells that keeps the same drive and rotation but reads the weight of the food continuously.

new_nodes.label: Strain-gauge weighing
new_nodes.detail: Bridge-amplifier load cells resolve weight changes of a few grams through the platter's rotation.

new_nodes.label: Mass-loss tracking
new_nodes.detail: Tracks water evaporated from the food, which for reheating and most cooking maps closely to how cooked it is.

ideas.rationale: Weight loss is a direct, food-agnostic measure of progress, so the user gets a live readout of doneness from a component that already sits in the cavity.

ideas.title: Battery-free chipless RFID tag replaces the interior lamp

new_nodes.label: Chipless RFID temperature tag
new_nodes.detail: A printed resonator placed under or beside the food whose resonant frequency shifts with temperature, requiring no battery or chip.

new_nodes.label: Passive wireless backscatter thermometry
new_nodes.detail: The cavity's antenna interrogates the tag through the door and decodes the frequency shift as core temperature.

new_nodes.label: Core temperature readout through door
new_nodes.detail: Shows the user the food's actual temperature on the control panel without opening the door or needing a light.

ideas.rationale: Knowing the food's real temperature answers the question the lamp only half-answered, and the tag costs cents and draws no power, so the lamp can be removed.

ideas.title: Aroma cartridge replaces the bell as a completion cue

new_nodes.label: Micro-encapsulated aroma cartridge with piezo atomizer
new_nodes.detail: A small swappable cartridge of food-safe flavour compounds that a piezo atomizer releases into the cavity exhaust when the cycle finishes.

new_nodes.label: Piezo micro-atomisation
new_nodes.detail: A vibrating ceramic disc turns a metered dose of liquid aroma into a fine mist at room temperature.

new_nodes.label: Olfactory completion cue
new_nodes.detail: Releases a distinct scent that tells the user the food is done, reaching them even when they are in another room.

new_edges.from: Micro-encapsulated aroma cartridge with piezo atomizer
Micro-encapsulated aroma cartridge with piezo atomizer

new_edges.to: Micro-encapsulated aroma cartridge with piezo atomizer

ideas.rationale: A smell is a feedback channel humans notice without looking or listening, so a scent that signals completion tells the user the food is ready more richly than a bell.

ideas.title: Progress Hum

new_nodes.label: Pitch-modulated magnetron acoustics
new_nodes.detail: The magnetron's own whine is shaped by a cheap oscillator so its pitch rises steadily as cooking progresses.

new_nodes.label: Progress tone generator
new_nodes.detail: A low-cost tone chip replaces the spring hammer and bell, sharing the existing power supply.

new_nodes.label: Reports cooking progress continuously
new_nodes.detail: The user hears how far through the cycle the food is without looking or counting.

ideas.rationale: A continuous sound that climbs toward a final note gives the user a running sense of how close the food is to ready, meeting the need for feedback where a single 'ding' gives none until the end.

ideas.title: Scent Sentinel

new_nodes.label: MEMS humidity and VOC sensing
new_nodes.detail: A mass-produced gas sensor reads the steam and aroma released by food as it heats.

new_nodes.label: Steam-sensing doneness controller
new_nodes.detail: A cheap sensor and microcontroller replace the mechanical cam, ending the cycle when the aroma curve indicates readiness.

new_nodes.label: Senses food state and ends cycle at doneness
new_nodes.detail: Cooking responds to what the food is doing rather than to elapsed time.

new_edges.to: Senses food state and ends cycle at doneness

new_edges.from: Senses food state and ends cycle at doneness

ideas.rationale: Sensing the food itself closes the loop, so the user gets feedback on readiness instead of trusting a guessed time.

ideas.title: Door Nudge

new_nodes.label: Spring-loaded door latch release
new_nodes.detail: The existing push-release spring is tuned so a cam can ease the door a few millimetres ajar at completion.

new_nodes.label: Ajar-on-done latch
new_nodes.detail: A cam-driven catch replaces the bell and lets the door open slightly when cooking finishes.

new_nodes.label: Gives tactile and visual end-of-cycle signal
new_nodes.detail: The gap is felt and seen, so it works for users who cannot hear the alert.

new_edges.to: Gives tactile and visual end-of-cycle signal

new_edges.from: Gives tactile and visual end-of-cycle signal

ideas.rationale: A door that physically opens a crack tells the user the food is ready in a way no one can miss, even across a noisy kitchen.

ideas.title: Glow Ring Progress

new_nodes.label: Edge-lit light-guide acrylic
new_nodes.detail: A clear acrylic ring around the turntable carries light from cheap LEDs and glows evenly.

new_nodes.label: Progress light ring
new_nodes.detail: A colour-shifting LED ring replaces the filament lamp and shows cycle progress as a filling arc.

new_nodes.label: Shows fraction of cooking completed
new_nodes.detail: A quick glance reveals how far through the cycle the food is.

ideas.rationale: A ring that fills as cooking proceeds turns the light into a progress bar, so the user always knows how far along the food is.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Doneness Dot

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic ink printed on glass
new_nodes.detail: A heat-reactive ink changes colour as the turntable and food reach set temperatures.

new_nodes.label: Doneness dot on turntable
new_nodes.detail: A printed disc on the glass turns from blue to red when the plate reaches serving heat.

new_nodes.label: Shows food temperature by colour
new_nodes.detail: The user sees readiness at a glance through the window without any electronics.

ideas.rationale: A colour change that is visible through the window gives a passive, zero-electronics readout of readiness, serving the need to know when food is done.

ideas.title: Daylight Light-Pipe Cavity Lamp

new_nodes.label: Ambient light collector
new_nodes.detail: Fresnel lens on the outer door face gathers room light and channels it through the door screen into the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Sub-cutoff metal light pipe
new_nodes.detail: Metal-walled light guide with an aperture below the 2.45 GHz waveguide cutoff, so RF stays contained while visible light passes.

new_nodes.label: Illuminate cavity without electricity
new_nodes.detail: Provides cavity visibility from ambient light only, drawing zero watts.

new_nodes.label: Dark cavity when room is unlit
new_nodes.detail: Without a lamp, the cavity is hard to see in a dark kitchen; the collector only partly mitigates this.

new_nodes.label: Passive optics
new_nodes.detail: Non-powered light collection and guidance.

new_edges.to: Dark cavity when room is unlit

ideas.rationale: Removing the 20-25 W lamp and replacing its light with passively piped ambient light cuts a continuous electrical load to zero while keeping the cavity visible.

ideas.title: Thermopile Endpoint Cooking
anchors: base_product:mechanical clockwork timer knob (0-30 min, bell)

new_nodes.label: Infrared thermopile array
new_nodes.detail: Non-contact sensor array mounted in the roof reads food surface temperature across the cavity and reports hot and cold zones.

new_nodes.label: Thermal-model cooking controller
new_nodes.detail: Microcontroller runs a heat-transfer model per food mass and predicts the endpoint, modulating power to reach it.

ideas.title: Dual-band 915 MHz defrost source

new_nodes.label: 915 MHz RF source for defrost
new_nodes.detail: A 915 MHz ISM-band oscillator (magnetron or solid-state) that replaces the 2.45 GHz magnetron during defrost mode.

new_nodes.label: Lower-frequency penetration into ice
new_nodes.detail: At 915 MHz the wave penetrates several centimetres into frozen food instead of about 1-2 cm, so the core thaws alongside the surface.

new_nodes.label: Volumetric thawing of frozen core
new_nodes.detail: Heats the centre of a frozen block at a rate close to its surface, cutting time to a usable thaw.

ideas.rationale: Deeper penetration into frozen food lets the core thaw at the same time as the surface, which shortens the time to a usable defrost and so serves M4.

ideas.title: Continuous solid-state low-power thawing

new_nodes.label: GaN RF power amplifier with continuous bias control
new_nodes.detail: A solid-state amplifier whose output is set continuously from 0 to 100% by drive level, replacing the magnetron and the cam switch.

new_nodes.label: Continuous amplitude-modulated RF generation
new_nodes.detail: Power is set by drive level rather than on/off duty cycle, so low power is steady rather than pulsed.

new_nodes.label: Steady sub-melt thawing without cycling peaks
new_nodes.detail: Holds the food just below melting so the surface never cooks while the centre thaws.

new_edges.from: GaN RF power amplifier with continuous bias control
GaN RF power amplifier with continuous bias control

Steady sub-melt thawing without cycling peaks

ideas.rationale: Steady sub-melt power avoids the pulse-induced hot spots that cook the outside of a frozen block while the inside stays frozen, which speeds up a clean defrost for M4.

ideas.title: Phased-array dual-feed electronic beam steering

new_nodes.label: Dual-feed phase-shifting RF controller
new_nodes.detail: Two RF feeds into the cavity with a programmed relative phase that moves the standing-wave pattern electronically.

new_nodes.label: Electronic standing-wave steering
new_nodes.detail: Changing the relative phase between feeds shifts hot spots across the load with no moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Stationary even field distribution
new_nodes.detail: Delivers an even field across a stationary frozen tray, removing the need to rotate the load.

ideas.rationale: Sweeping the field electronically across a stationary frozen load prevents any corner from staying frozen while another begins to cook, which speeds even defrosting and serves M4.

ideas.title: Thaw-endpoint sensing replaces the user timer

new_nodes.label: Waveguide reflected-power sensor
new_nodes.detail: Measures reflected RF power and load impedance, which change sharply when ice turns to liquid water.

new_nodes.label: Phase-change detection via dielectric loss
new_nodes.detail: Ice has low dielectric loss and liquid water absorbs strongly, so measured loss tracks thaw progress.

new_nodes.label: Self-timing defrost endpoint
new_nodes.detail: Reduces power or ends the cycle at the ice-to-water transition, so the user does not need to guess a time.

ideas.rationale: Ending the defrost at the ice-to-water transition removes the guesswork that leaves centres partly frozen or edges cooked, so frozen food thaws quickly and safely for M4.

ideas.title: Ferrite-loaded conductive defrost plate

new_nodes.label: Ferrite-loaded ceramic defrost plate
new_nodes.detail: A lossy ceramic plate that absorbs microwaves and conducts heat into the frozen block from below, replacing the glass turntable.

new_nodes.label: Susceptor-driven conductive heating
new_nodes.detail: The lossy ceramic converts RF energy to heat in the plate, which then transfers heat by conduction to the contacting ice.

new_nodes.label: Contact thawing of frozen block
new_nodes.detail: Conduction from the plate supplements dielectric heating at the frozen underside.

ideas.rationale: Adding conductive heat from below the frozen block gives a second heating path that thaws the underside faster and smooths out standing-wave hot spots, serving M4.
